N05 ★★ BACK leaves the SCREEN instead of returning to the PROVISION menu (the containment contract, broken)
N06 ★★ ANY double ACTS, not just the one on a TEAM row — leaving the list opens a JOIN confirmation

V05 ★★★ the open window WRITES `_last_input_ms` on every tick — the panel never blanks and the node never light-sleeps while it is up (OQ-3's refusal)

V07 ★★★ the confirmation does NOT freeze the selection — every refresh re-points it at the row under the cursor, so a member arriving between the two presses moves the target (F-14)

V09 ★★★ the window's `left != 0` term is dropped — at the EXACT deadline the window is still open, so the five-minute bound is five minutes and one millisecond (`wake_active`'s edge, lost)
V10 ★★★ the request is AUTO-ISSUED on candidate entry — the operator never selected REQUEST PUBKEY or double-confirmed it (the owner-ratified ban reversed)
V11 ★★ the NEED PUBKEY confirmation defaults to REQUEST PUBKEY instead of BACK — an immediate double airs it
V12 ★★★ the request timeout ENABLES GRANT KEY although no matching key arrived
V13 ★★★ the PRESENCE OF A NAME enables GRANT KEY even when the key is only overheard (display metadata makes an airtime-and-secret decision)
V14 ★★★ the WAITING FOR PUBKEY screen is entered whatever the seam answered — an unattached seam and a synchronous refusal both claim an outstanding request (the QG blocker, restored)
